calendar_mismatch_detail: both are documented one-off NYSE closures not modeled by the hand-rolled calendar: 2018-12-05 (National Day of Mourning, G.H.W. Bush) and 2025-01-09 (National Day of Mourning, J. Carter)
universe_selection_method: static, hand-picked before any download or backtest: large-cap liquid US equities diversified across 10 GICS-style sectors, chosen for long trading history back to 2017; not selected or filtered based on any backtest result
data_source: Yahoo Finance via yfinance 1.6.0, auto_adjust=False, adjusted_close used for all returns
known_bias_caveats: Survivorship bias: universe is current, liquid large caps -- any company that failed or was delisted since 2017 is absent by construction. This is a real limitation, not detectable from the data itself.
Adjusted-close restatement: vendors retroactively restate history after corporate actions, so re-running this download next month may not reproduce bit-identical prices.
